description.narrative: Absa is sub-Saharan Africa's third largest bank, operating in 14 countries.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

description.narrative: We provided a trade loan to Absa Group Ltd (Absa) to increase the availability of US dollar liquidity for trade finance on the African continent. During the COVID-19 pandemic we increased our commitment to provide additional counter-cyclical support and help mitigate the indirect economic impacts of the crisis.The trade loan allows Absa to increase lending to domestic banks in Africa, which in turn allows them to support trading businesses with the imports of commodities, goods and equipment, and ultimately support economic opportunities and access to goods for people.
